answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 7403 Country: India Title: When i went for umrah to makkah and i was in ihram i touched hajrae aswad with my hand as i didnt know tat perfumed is applied to hajrae aswad.since i touched it unknowingly,does i have to give dum tat is do i have to sacrifice animal for tat. Question: assalamualaikum. When i went for umrah to makkah and i was in ihram i touched hajrae aswad with my hand as i didnt know tat perfumed is applied to hajrae aswad.since i touched it unknowingly,does i have to give dum tat is do i have to sacrifice animal for tat. jazakallah Answer ID: 7403 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1775/1360=D/1429) In the abovementioned case, if the perfume was applied to the palm and fingers and the hand was scented then you have to give damm (animal for slaughtering). If it is applied to fingers only then sadqah (charity) is wajib . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
